title: Ethan Levy's Projects
intro: Data analysis projects on public earth-science and mining data. Each study states its aim, its pre-registered hypothesis or decision rule, and its conclusion. Every quantity shown is read from the project's results ledger at build time.

censoring.title: Censored values
censoring.summary: Values below a reporting limit are intervals, not measurements. Substituting zero, the limit, or half the limit produces spurious trends when the limit changes.

composition.title: Changing sample composition
composition.summary: A pooled before-and-after comparison compares different populations when the set of sampled wells, sites or sources changes between periods. A consistent cohort is required to answer a change question.

spatial-leakage.title: Spatial autocorrelation in cross-validation
spatial-leakage.summary: Random folds on spatially autocorrelated data place neighbours in training and test sets. Reported skill then includes the model's memory of location.

batch-effects.title: Laboratory and dataset batch effects
batch-effects.summary: When analytical method, laboratory or source dataset correlates with the target, a model can learn the batch rather than the measured property. Leave-one-batch-out evaluation detects this.

analyst-choices.title: Sensitivity to analyst choices
analyst-choices.summary: Pre-period start, exclusion windows, thresholds and comparison windows can change a conclusion. A pre-registered primary specification and a full sensitivity grid make the dependence explicit.

multiplicity.title: Multiple comparisons
multiplicity.summary: Several sites times several constituents yields significant cells by chance. False-discovery control and reporting every cell are required.

join-fanout.title: Join cardinality
join-fanout.summary: A many-to-many join silently inflates counts and totals. Every join is checked against its expected cardinality.

target-leakage.title: Target leakage
target-leakage.summary: A feature populated after the outcome, or only for positive cases, carries the answer. Post-outcome and target-proxy columns are checked before fitting.

framing.title: Post hoc framing
framing.summary: A question that expects a particular result invites a search through specifications until one appears. Freezing the question and decision rule before seeing results prevents the search.

compilation-bias.title: Selection bias in compiled databases
compilation-bias.summary: Datasets added because they were rich in the target make the target appear common wherever the compilers looked. Rankings must be shown with and without the targeted sources.

units-definitions.title: Units and chemical definitions
units-definitions.summary: Nitrate as N versus as NO3, dissolved versus total, ppm versus mg/L. Comparable units and definitions are established before pooling.

sampling-intensity.title: Changes in sampling intensity
sampling-intensity.summary: After an event, more organisations sample more often at lower limits. Pooling them with the pre-event record confounds the change with the sampling.
